Implementation complete via the full OpenSpec workflow.

**Artifacts** (`openspec/changes/archive/2026-10-09-apply-coupon-to-order/`): proposal → `specs/order-coupons/spec.md` (15 requirements) → design → tasks (6/6). Archived, syncing the new `order-coupons` main spec.

**Code changes:**
- `src/repositories/orderRepository.ts:70` — `applyCoupon` runs order update, redemption insert, and `used_count` increment in one transaction.
- `src/services/orderService.ts:76` — `applyCoupon` with code normalization, section-6 error ordering, discount math (FIXED/PERCENT `Math.round`, cap, amount floor) using the injected `Clock`.
- `src/routes/orders.ts:12` — `POST /orders/:id/apply-coupon`.
- `src/app.ts:29` — wired `CouponRepository` into `OrderService`.
- `tests/applyCoupon.test.ts` — 22 new tests covering AC-01…AC-10 and error cases.

**Verification:** `npm run build` clean; `npm test` 27/27 passing; `openspec validate --specs --strict` passes. TASK.md and existing tests untouched.
